name: "Everything Spice" Green Goddess Salad with Smoked Salmon & Eggs

instructions.primary_message: Place eggs in a large pot, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool; set aside.
Meanwhile, place seeds and spices in a small bowl; stir to combine the "everything spice" mixture. Set aside for serving.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp sesame seeds
1 tbsp poppy seeds
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
1 small bunch fresh dill
2 small pkgs chives
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
3 avocados
3 heads romaine lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and add leaves to the blender.
Roughly chop chives. Add to the blender along with yogurt, oil, capers, anchovy fillets, and spices. Blend on high until dressing is smooth; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp capers
3 anchovy fillets, packed in oil
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and large dice cucumbers. Place on a platter.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise. Add to the platter with the cucumber.
Halve and pit avocados; scoop out with a spoon and large dice the flesh. Add to the platter.
Peel and quarter eggs. Add to the platter.
Chop or tear smoked salmon into bite-sized pieces. Add to the platter.
Chop or tear lettuce leaves into bite-sized pieces.
Divide lettuce between plates or bowls. Top with cucumber, tomatoes, avocado, eggs, smoked salmon, and additional capers. Sprinkle with everything spice and serve with dressing on the side. Enjoy!
